sentences.fa: تعارف ندارم، تازه رسيدم خسته ام.
sentences.en: It's not a compliment, I have just arrived.
Shall call an ambulance?

sentences.fa: شما چرا ميز رو تميز کني وقتي من اينجام؟
sentences.en: There is no sense in cleaning the table if I am here to do it?

sentences.fa: لطف داري تعارف مي کني، من اينجا ميزبانم تعارف نمي کنم.
sentences.en: It is nice of you to offer me, I am the host here and it's not a compliment.
Look I insist.
I'm trying to stop it.
Stay here.
Common I insist.
Are you staying here?
I'm getting back home, my mom is alone.
You are not moving that desk by yourself!
You are not staying here for dinner!
You are not eating lunch!

sentences.fa: ميز رو که خودت جابجا نمي کني. تازه از بيمارستان مرخص شدي.
sentences.en: You are not moving the desk by yourself; you have just been released from the hospital.

sentences.fa: نمي خوام زحمتت بدم، مهمون داري. دستت بنده.
sentences.en: I don't want to trouble you, you have got some guests. You are up to doing something.

sentences.fa: نمي خوام زحمتت بدم، ديرت شده.
sentences.en: I don't want to trouble you, you are late.
I don't want to put you in trouble.

sentences.fa: نمي خوام تو زحمت بندازمت آخه خيلي زحمت کشيدي.
sentences.en: I don't want to put you in trouble because you have taken a strive.
Would you like me to give you a ride?
Sorry for disturbing you.
I don't want to inconvenience you.
Sorry for troubling you.

sentences.fa: مي تونم آدرست رو داشته باشم؟
sentences.en: Can I have your address?
I don't want you to put in trouble.

sentences.fa: نه چه زحمتي! وظيفمو انجام دادم.
sentences.en: No trouble at all. I have done my duty.

sentences.fa: باور كن، خوشحالم که بهتون کمک کنم.
sentences.en: Honestly, I am happy to give you a hand.

sentences.fa: باور كن، خوشحالم که بهتون کمک مي کنم.
sentences.en: Honestly, I am happy to lend the hand.
I don't mind washing the dishes.

sentences.fa: بخدا اگه بذارم صورتحسابو شما پرداخت كني.
sentences.en: There is no sense in paying the bill if I am here to do it.

sentences.fa: بخدا اگه بذارم صورت حساب رو پرداخت کني.
sentences.en: I don't mind paying the bill.

words.en: I don't want to inconvenience you

proverb.fa: هيچ وقت با ساندويچ به ساندويچ فروشي نمي رن.
proverb.en: You never take sand to the beach.
